notes.title: Optimized New Steam Achievements
notes.content:
Thank you for your recent feedback on the new Steam achievements. 
[h2]According to player feedback, on January 6, 2025 new changes significantly reduced the amount of achievements to 40 achievements to follow the cozy and casual game vibe of GPGP Steam.[/h2]

[h1]The 40 new achievements will be synced with your game progress with the new game version 5.21.0 coming this afternoon.[/h1]

[b]Changes:[/b]
• Removed most "tiered" achievements: achievements with numbers 'I, II, III, etc'
• Created a new, simplified Steam-only achievements to continue the satisfaction of 100% maxing out the game.
- 'Done And Dusted I, II, III, IV and V' for completing each chapter of the game
• [b]Removed unrealistic high tiered achievements[/b] from 'Ovenist', ' Pizza Entrepreneur', 'Consistency', 'In Business', 'Place x topping 500-1000 times', and 'Delivery Master'.
- If you really want to achieve all 300+ achievements in game, they still can be achieved in the game directly for Pizza Gems in the MyPad, but are removed on Steam achievements.
• [b]Removed the old unachievable achievements[/b]: 'Tip Top Shop', 'Consistent Yet Intense', 'Smells of Skunk', 'Pizza Genius' and 'A Great Start'
• Modified 2 old achievements as simpler requirements: 'Great Service' and 'Toppings For Days' 
• [b]Removed unachievable 'watch x ad' achievements[/b]

[b]Done And Dusted Achievements work as follows. Please see if you still have an issue![/b]

[b]• CH 1 - At the end of day 21[/b] (most likely, because very old players might have longer chapter 1)
[b]- It is also a day after this PNN appears:[/b]

It seems after the recent game update to 5.18.2 and higher, some players using a Windows PC have been receiving a [b]Trojan Virus warning from attempting to run the game[/b] on their computer.

notes.title: Steam Achievement Fixes/ Clarifications!
notes.content:
Hello Steam Ovenists!

A lot of players have been asking us to fix or check our achievements, so we went through each of them we were asked about, then tested and checked if they fully work. Two achievements were bugged so those were fixed as well!

Please see here for fixes/ requirements/ clarifications on frequently asked achievements.

[b][h1]Achievements We Looked Into:[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] "[b]Pizza![/b]" - Make 50 pizzas. [spoiler] Achievable if player makes 50 pizzas accumulated from all game days played so far. [/spoiler]
[*] "[b]You're A Business![/b]" - Earn $500. [spoiler] Achievable if player earns at least $500 Pizza Funds in profit accumulated from all game days played so far. [/spoiler]
[*] "[b]Tip Top Shop[/b]" - Unlock all currently released upgrades. [spoiler] Achievable if player unlocked every single upgrade in the 'Upgrades' tab from Chapters 1-5. [/spoiler]
[*] "[b]Toppings for Days[/b]" - Unlock all currently released toppings. [spoiler] Achievable if player unlocked every topping in the 'Toppings' tab and Figs, Zucchini & Artichokes from Chapters 1-5. [/spoiler]
[*] "[b]You Tried[/b]" - Close shop on Day 1. [spoiler] Hidden achievement. Achievable if player has gone bankrupt (Pizza Funds need to be a negative) on Day 1. Probably very hard to go bankrupt if any pizzas made. [/spoiler]
[*] "[b]Bear Buddy[/b]" - Befriend the bear hobo. [spoiler] Hidden achievement. Achievable if player has fed pizza to the bear buddy hobo 6 times by Day 20. Unavailable if player didn't feed hobo or refused hobo even once before Day 20. [/spoiler]
[*] "[b]Consistent, Yet Intense[/b]" - Get a 5 star critic review. [spoiler] Hidden achievement. 2 chances - one on Day 7 and another on Day 13 in Chapter 1. 
Achievable if player has fed the TV personality critic a satisfactory pepperoni pizza scoring higher than 80% during chapter 1. Achievement given as soon as pizza is handed to the critic - no need to see reviews/ interview section. [/spoiler]
[*] "[b]Smells of Skunk[/b]" - Get a 1 star critic review. [spoiler] Hidden achievement. 2 chances - one on Day 7 and another on Day 13 in Chapter 1. 
Achievable if player has fed the TV personality critic an unsatisfactory pepperoni pizza scoring lower than 20% during chapter 1. Achievement given as soon as pizza is handed to the critic - no need to see reviews/ interview section.[/spoiler]
[*] "[b]Have a Heart, Buddy[/b]" - Feed both hobos. [spoiler] Hidden achievement. Achievable if player has fed at least 1 pizza to each of the two homeless men in Chapter 1. 
Bear buddy hobo must be fed before reaching Day 20. Rufus Goldworthy hobo must be fed before the end of chapter 1. 
Both homeless men come back just once if the player has refused them pizza at any time. Unavailable if player fed only one hobo or didn't feed any hobos. [/spoiler]
[*] [BUGGED] "[b]Good Service[/b]" - Fixed with 5.3.2. Serve 8 customers in one day. [spoiler] Achievable if player serves at least 8 customers (not counting refunds) in a single game day. [/spoiler]
[*] [BUGGED] "[b]Za[/b]" - Fixed with 5.3.2. Make 25 blank pizzas. [spoiler] Hidden achievement. Achievable if player served at least 25 "blank" pizzas - meaning flatbread made of just dough with nothing on it - accumulated from all game days played so far. Achievement does not exist as a MyPad achievement, just as a hidden Steam achievement. [/spoiler]
[*] "[b]The Saucemaker[/b]" - Help the daters. [spoiler] Hidden achievement. Achievable if player successfully, without refund, makes all 4 unique "dating" orders that appear randomly  as a regular order. This one takes longer as it relies on luck of random order generation.
Orders:
"Onion pizza, please. I'm going on a date."
"I need an onion and anchovy pizza to ruin this date."
"I need an onion and anchovy pizza to make this date memorable."
"I need a pineapple pizza to see which side of the debate my date is on."
 [/spoiler]
[*] "[b]Deep Dish Intimidation[/b]" - Ignore the Deep Dish Gang. [spoiler] Hidden achievement. Achievable if player has refused all 3 pizza request from the robber in Chapter 2. Unavailable if player didn't reject all times during Chapter 2. 
Any other encounters with the robber outside of Chapter 2 are not counted. Interactions with the Robber as Flash in Chapter 5 does not count. [/spoiler]
[/list]

We hope this guide helps to clear some misunderstandings and confusions! Thank you :)

notes.title: Goodbye Early Access! Good Pizza Launches Officially On Steam Jan. 6, 2023!
notes.content:
[b]Goodbye Early Access![/b]
Thank you for cooking with us through thick and thin! Good Pizza, Great Pizza Steam is finally having it's official launch today, January 6, 2023 2PM PST!
Thanks to everyone's support, we are finally leaving Early Access on Steam and officially launching as a Steam PC game. 

[b]This means more exclusive features and gifts on steam as well as a few changes to the gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*]All Early Access players will receive a $7.99 value DLC pack "Cyber Pizzeria Set". This only includes players that have purchased the game before January 6th, 2023 PST! All other players will have the DLC available for purchase at its regular price.
[*]We are also working on a multi-save slot feature and zen mode for Steam in 2023.
[*]Upon launch, we will fully utilize data back up systems through the Steam server.
- This means upon official launch, we are discontinuing the TapBlaze ID transfers and syncs to and from mobile, amazon, tablet devices as GPGP Steam will be established as it's own entity (Days, currencies, achievements, items and other data will not sync or transfer).
- From January 6, 2023, players are no longer able to sync or transfer game data between mobile and Steam game.
